* '''GPN category:''' Standard

== Strategy ==

Your Average Trooper Deck.

Blast Points to get out the Disruptor Pistols, of to add Battle Destinies.

Trooper Assault - Nuff Said.

Disruptor Pistol - The High Destinies Allow you to really mess with low ability characters - really stinks when your Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner is lost before he adds power. Send em to used pile to soak up attrition or battle damage.

Precise Attack - Jedi Aren't Hard To Kill, really.

Strategic Reserves - Cancel Force Drains. Light Side Monnok Card Protection.

Skiff - Quick Movemement

Trooper Sabacc - Get Some Patrol Craft if they have them or just make them lost one to two force.
